name: probe_media
description: Look up a video or audio link without downloading it. Use it first to learn the title, duration, uploader and the available qualities (format ids); for a playlist or multi-video post it lists the entries instead.

url.description: Link to the video, audio or playlist page.

name: start_download
description: Start downloading a video or audio link in the background and return the new download right away (state queued). Poll get_download with its id until the state is done, then use the file link it returns.

clip.description: Keep only a time range of the media.

end.description: End, in seconds. Omit to run to the end.

format.description: Output format: mp4, mkv or mov for video; mp3, m4a, opus, flac or wav for audio only.

playlist_item.description: 1-based item to download when the link is a multi-video post (see probe_media playlist entries).

quality.description: A format id from probe_media (formats[].id) to pick a resolution. Omit for the best quality.

strip_metadata.description: Remove title, author and other metadata from the output file.

url.description: Link to the video or audio page.

name: list_downloads
description: List the caller's recent downloads with their state (queued, downloading, processing, done, cancelled, failed, expired) and progress. Use it to find a download id or to see what is still running.

name: get_download
description: Get one download's state, progress and error. When the file is ready (state done) the result also carries a link to fetch it.

id.description: Download id, as returned by start_download or list_downloads.

name: cancel_download
description: Cancel a queued or running download. It has no effect on a download that already finished.

id.description: Download id, as returned by start_download or list_downloads.

name: get_transcript
description: Return a video's subtitles as plain text, without downloading the media: manual subtitles when they exist, otherwise automatic captions. Use it to read, summarize or search what is said. Fails with unavailable when the video has no subtitles.

language.description: BCP-47 language code such as en, fr or pt-BR. Default: the video's original language, then en.
